question: Does the frozen calibrated receiver predict a fresh known incident single and counterpropagating-pair local clock record under every Program 15.7 control?

method.action: Unchanged radial SS OCF1 Hamiltonian; exact formal neutral orders1,3 and charged/clock orders0,2,4, unfitted.
method.units: c=hbar=m=1; time and radius m^-1; clock difference in cycles.
method.domain: R80 with h.1,.05,.025; independent R160 at h.1; fixed readout r.1.
method.boundaries: Regular origin and zero outer boundary; no sponge; duration65 before outer return.
method.initial_data: Accepted frozen core/mode; fresh compact incoming cos^4 shells centered19,27 with width3.25; known preparation available to predictor, upstream record saved.
method.solver: Shared RK4 Hamiltonian; dt.01,.005; full time-dependent Taylor response, no adiabatic assumption.
method.tolerances: Program 5% or combined numerical budget; nonzero interval >5 budgets; no changes after lock.

hypotheses.prediction: Unfitted fourth-order known-incident forecast meets local interval gates and required controls.
A resolved discrepancy, nonquadratic weak response, control failure or excessive uncertainty rejects acceptance.

prohibited_inferences: No retroactive promotion of old surface-only runs.
Known preparation is explicit: no claim of robust surface-only inversion.
Fixed local timers and quiet counterfactual are not an autonomous detector.
A radial Test7 pass does not establish Test8 survival/recoil, Test9 invariance or emergent geometry.
